de: By the decision of the court of general jurisdiction of Yerevan, Gagik Tsarukyan, leader of the Prosperous Armenia party, extended his arrest for three months.

d: Финляндия требует сократить долгосрочный бюджет Европейского союза, но не исключает отдельные варианты финансирования Украины, заявил в интервью порталу Rapporteur (бывший Euractiv) министр по европейским делам Финляндии Иоаким Странд.

te: A foreigner tried to take mercury from Blagoveshchensk to China
de: At the checkpoint Blagoveshchensk customs officers found mercury in the luggage of a foreigner who was going to leave for the Chinese city of Heihe. This was reported in the press service of the Khabarovsk customs.

te: Medvedev urged to crush the enemy to complete victory, despite the US elections
